capabilities: Render styled tag labels from ((tag|label|color)) syntax
Apply predefined or custom hex colors
Fall back to grey for invalid colors
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not manage Obsidian's #tag system; it renders inline styled status labels.
extras: Same ((tag|label|color)) syntax shared with VS Code and VitePress editions; documentation and live demo linked externally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline syntax for colored status labels or arrow badges inside Markdown text.

relations.evidence: The VS Code extension is the main project: start there for the syntax reference
The same ((tag|label|color)) syntax is available in other tools.

summary: Markdown syntax plugin that renders styled, colored tag labels and arrow tags for statuses like todo, done, and blocked in Obsidian.
